uncited: It builds on [Marching Cubes Lookup and Configuration](2518-marching-cubes-lookup-and-configuration.md) for the underlying topology.
- **Step**: Execute each operation on all cubes (or cubes with the same properties) simultaneously on the condition that there is no dependency among cubes.
Vectorize the determination of cases for each cube and vertices of triangles (bilinear interpolation).
Vectorize computation of table lookup index values.
Subdivide $T$ based on the magnitude of $E_T$ to ensure error stays below a given threshold.

- **Formula**: The linearization error at a point $p$ on the deformed surface is $E(p) = \| \mathbf{p} - D(\widetilde{D^{-1}}(\mathbf{p})) \|$, where $\widetilde{D^{-1}}$ is the approximate inverse from the hull.
